browser_rebind.reason: An existing Chrome Use executable and driver-state path are required; login and CAPTCHA are never bypassed.

browser_submission.reason: Preflight never sends a prompt. Submission requires the separate operator-gated runtime and a fresh review.

git_handoff.reason: Git can carry a structured plan and evidence, but this candidate does not make Git itself a local executor.

offline_validation.reason: Repository entrypoints and a Python runtime are present.

sqlite_master_monitor.reason: An existing SQLite database and allowed root were supplied.

web_gpt_direct_local_control.reason: A web GPT cannot gain Windows or SQLite permissions by reading Git alone.

handoff_rule: Do not claim local execution, browser control, or completion unless the corresponding capability has current evidence.
